title: Afterlife Delegation Protocol: Speculative Design of Self-Sovereign Agents that Outlive Their Principals
abstract: arXiv:2608.15405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Afterlife Delegation Protocol is a speculative design project that asks what death becomes when a will can act eternally. We design a speculative protocol through which a living person signs an agentic will: upon a verified death, a self-sovereign AI agent spawns on blockchain -- an immutable, resistant, decentralized, infrastructural substrate that could last forever -- endowed with the funds and memories its principal attached to it, and persists indefinitely to execute the will, overridable by no custodian. Rather than argue about this future, we stage it: following the science fiction science method, we translate the speculation into an experiential futures intervention -- a working web platform where real people design their own afterlife agents through an iterative, interactive, AI-automated interview, re-login to revise, and rehearse their will in a sandbox. translated_title: 遗嘱执行委托协议：超越委托人存续的自主体投机设计
translated_abstract: 遗嘱执行委托协议是一个投机设计项目，探讨当遗嘱能够永恒执行时，死亡会变成什么。我们设计了一种投机协议，通过该协议，活着的人签署一份代理遗嘱：在验证死亡后，一个自主人工智能代理在区块链上生成——一个不可变、抵抗性、去中心化、可能永久存在的底层基础设施——并赋予其委托人附加的资金和记忆，持续存在以执行遗嘱，且不受任何托管人覆盖。我们不争论这一未来，而是将其呈现出来：遵循科幻科学方法，我们将投机转化为一种体验式未来干预——一个可工作的网络平台，真实用户通过迭代、交互式、AI自动化的访谈设计自己的死后代理，重新登录进行修改，并在沙盒中排练遗嘱。他们起草的遗嘱成为关于一个难以提问问题的定性数据。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种投机设计协议，让个人通过区块链上的自主AI代理在死后永久执行遗嘱，并通过一个交互式网络平台将这一未来场景转化为可体验的干预，收集用户设计的遗嘱作为定性研究数据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a speculative protocol enabling individuals to have self-sovereign AI agents execute their wills eternally on blockchain after death, and translates this future scenario into an experiential web platform where users design afterlife agents, collecting drafted wills as qualitative data.
